name: forward_bitmap_blit_call
description: Forwards a single argument-free call into the graphics library through its jump vector and returns the two result registers the library leaves behind. The routine is a thin wrapper, and its callers rely on it to run the graphics blit.

name: blit_sprite_table_entries
description: Walks a table of sprite records, clamping each record's horizontal position against a limit and passing its position, size and bitmap fields to the graphics library. The table index advances by a stride taken from a global counter capped at six, and the walk stops at the end of the table.

name: fade_palette_in_steps
description: Builds thirteen palette levels by scaling each 4-bit red, green and blue value of a source palette by a rising factor and adding a fixed offset. Each level is loaded, and two routines run three times per step; a flag is cleared and the step recorded when a condition holds.

name: fade_palette_out_steps
description: Steps a palette from full strength down to zero across thirteen levels by scaling each colour channel, loading each level and running two routines per step. It sets a flag at the end when the fade-complete condition holds.

name: ramp_palette_brightness_steps
description: Ramps a palette from black to full brightness across sixteen levels by scaling each 4-bit colour channel and loading each level. Two routines run per step, and the final level is recorded in a global.

name: fade_palette_from_full_brightness
description: Fades a palette from full brightness down to black over sixteen levels, loading each level into the display and waiting for the frame before the next step. It sets a completion flag when the fade ends.

name: abort_io_until_cleared
description: Repeatedly calls the exec library's abort-I/O entry on a stored request block until it returns zero, cancelling any outstanding transfers before the routine returns.

name: wait_io_until_complete
description: Repeatedly calls the exec library's wait-for-I/O entry on a stored request block until it returns zero, so the routine blocks until the transfer finishes.

name: handle_board_file_selection
description: Ignores input while a flag is set; otherwise it either clears the record table or selects one record by index, sets its state fields and calls library routines. The referenced text covers the board filename prompt, the missing-file message and the scores file name.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens the DOS library through the exec library's open entry and stores the returned base for later calls. The routine references the dos.library name.

name: open_intuition_library
description: Opens the intuition library through the exec library's open entry and stores the returned base in a global slot.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a previously opened library through the exec library's close entry, using the library base held in a global.

name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens the graphics library through the exec library's open entry and stores its base in a global slot for later graphics calls.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a previously opened library through the exec library's close entry, using the library base held in a global.

name: open_diskfont_library
description: Opens the diskfont library through the exec library's open entry and stores its base in a global slot.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a previously opened library through the exec library's close entry, using the library base held in a global.

name: open_iff_library_checked
description: Opens the iff library and stores its base; if the open fails, it points a data slot at a fixed data area instead. The referenced text is an error message reporting that the iff library file cannot be found.

name: close_library_via_exec
description: Closes a previously opened library through the exec library's close entry, using the library base held in a global.

name: load_music_by_available_memory
description: Compares the free memory reported by the system against a set of size thresholds, and when enough is available it allocates a buffer, opens the music file and reads it in. Chunk offsets are recorded from the thresholds before the file is handled.

name: copy_block_then_load_scores
description: Copies a block of longwords up to a fixed end address, then opens the scores file, reads it and calls two library routines when the read succeeds. The referenced text includes the scores file name.

name: write_scores_file
description: Opens the scores file, writes a block through the DOS library and closes it, calling the write and close entries only when the open succeeds. The referenced text is the scores file name.

name: load_ball_iff_colour_table
description: Loads the colour table of the ball image through the iff library and, if the call fails, points a data slot at a fixed area and reports the error. The referenced text names the ball image file and the colour table error message.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Does nothing and returns; the routine is an empty stub reached from two call sites.

name: decode_ball_iff_picture
description: Decodes an IFF picture through the iff library and, when decoding fails, points a data slot at a fixed area and reports the failure. The referenced message states that the decode step failed on invalid IFF data.

name: open_custom_screen_checked
description: Opens a custom intuition screen and stores the result, and on failure points a data slot at a fixed area instead. The referenced text reports that the custom screen could not be opened.

name: open_intuition_window
description: Opens an intuition window and stores its handle in a global slot for later drawing calls.

name: open_main_window_checked
description: Opens the main intuition window, storing the handle and redirecting a data slot to a fixed area when the open fails. The referenced text reports that the main window could not be opened.

name: generate_random_quotient_remainder
description: Advances a 16-bit pseudo-random state by multiplying and mixing it with fixed constants and a call counter, then returns the scrambled value split into a quotient and remainder for a divisor. An extra adjustment is applied once the counter passes 199.

name: call_routines_when_flagged
description: Calls two routines only when a flag is set, and otherwise returns without doing anything.

name: call_routines_when_flagged
description: Calls two routines only when a flag is set, and otherwise returns without doing anything.

name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls a single routine and returns zero. It is entered from outside the normal flow through a pointer held in data.

name: forward_call_and_return_result
description: Calls one routine and passes through the two result registers that routine leaves.

name: initialise_sequence_playback
description: Scans the sequence order table for the next entry, builds pattern pointer records for that sequence, clears the playback counters and marks playback as active.

name: reset_channels_and_start_sequence
description: Clears the four channel levels, scans the sequence order table to build pattern records, and sets the playback flags. The routine writes the audio volume registers and touches the fire-button port in the process.

name: silence_audio_channels_when_flagged
description: When a playback flag is set, it clears the flag and silences the four audio channels by zeroing their volumes and clearing the audio DMA bits. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: advance_playback_and_reload_audio
description: Steps the playback position through the order table with wrap-around at 128, jumping back to the loop start at the end marker. While playback is active it also reloads the channel start-address registers from a table and waits briefly before continuing.

name: decode_pattern_cell_effects
description: Decodes one four-byte pattern cell, storing the sample pointer, length and period for its channel, then applies a volume, speed or effect command from the cell's low nibble. Values are clamped to their limits, and the DMA control register is updated for the mute command.

name: copy_record_word_to_target
description: Copies a 16-bit field from a state record into a target location passed by pointer.

name: scale_channel_volume_by_master
description: Multiplies a channel's sample volume by the master volume and stores the scaled result in the channel record. Surrounding setup in the same routine loads channel start, length and DMA registers.

name: update_countdown_channel_flag
description: Masks a 12-bit field of a state record and compares it with a stored target, clearing the counter on equality and setting a flag when the value is below the target.

name: lookup_table_value_by_threshold
description: Selects one of three fields by a global counter taken modulo three, then scans a table of 36 entries for the first value not below the record's threshold and stores the match in the record.

name: boot_reset_and_jump
description: Boot entry point that calls the reset routine and then jumps to the program's main code address held in a global.

name: loop_forever_stub
description: Loops endlessly without doing any work; the bytes are a gap that decodes as code and the routine is never reached in normal flow.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stub made of data bytes that the decompiler reads as an invalid instruction. It has no behaviour and is never reached.

name: setup_task_node_and_loop
description: The decompiled body is only an endless loop, but the library calls it makes show that the entry finds the current task, allocates memory and adds a node to a list before looping.

name: decrement_and_release_resources
description: Decrements a countdown field in a record and, when the field reaches zero with a pending bit set, runs the release routine again. When a cleanup flag is set it frees memory and removes the node from its list through the exec library.

name: release_node_or_mark_pending
description: Releases the node through the exec library and returns its stored result when the countdown field is zero. Otherwise it sets a pending bit in the record and returns zero.

name: free_node_and_return_result
description: Removes a node from its list, closes its associated library, frees its memory through the exec library, and returns the result stored in the record.

name: find_chunk_by_tag
description: Walks a list of length-prefixed chunks that follow a header, comparing each chunk's tag with the requested value. It returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the end of the list is reached, with each chunk padded to an even length.

name: return_call_result_plus_eight
description: Calls a subroutine and returns its result with eight added to it. The recovered body is partial, so the wider behaviour rests on the six routines it calls.

name: copy_block_bytes_by_count
description: Copies bytes one at a time from the source to the destination until the count held in the data register expires.

name: copy_block_bytes_checked_first
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination, testing the count before each byte, until the counter wraps past zero.

name: unpack_packbits_run_stream
description: Decodes a PackBits-style run-length stream: a negative control byte repeats the next byte, while a non-negative control byte copies that many following bytes literally, until the output count is used up.

name: unpack_rle_repeat_and_literal
description: Decodes a run-length stream in which each control byte either repeats a byte a set number of times or copies literal bytes, writing output until the count reaches zero.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without doing any other work. It is reached only from a gap in the program.

name: write_ilbm_picture_file
description: Writes an IFF ILBM picture: it emits the form, picture-type and header chunk tags, converts each source word into three bytes of packed data, and writes the result through the DOS library.

name: finish_file_write_and_close
description: Checks the result of the preceding write, calls the file write sequence through the DOS library on success, and closes the file. When a flag is set and the write fails, it closes the file before returning.

name: close_file_if_flagged
description: Closes the open file through the DOS library when a flag is set, then calls a subroutine.

name: emit_weighted_row_sums
description: Computes eight weighted sums from a 16-bit header record and a multiplier, then writes each value with repeated DOS write calls and stops early if a call returns an error.

name: emit_weighted_sums_and_total
description: Computes eight weighted sums like its neighbour, but also accumulates a running total from a routine call and writes the values through the DOS library, stopping on the first error.

name: pack_bytes_packbits_stream
description: Packs a source buffer into a PackBits-style stream by choosing repeat or literal runs, writing a control byte before each run and counting the bytes written. It stops when the source is used up or the output limit is reached.

name: pack_literal_bytes_packbits
description: Writes a literal run of bytes into a PackBits-style output, emitting a count byte and copying the bytes until a repeat is detected or the limit is reached. It returns the number of bytes written so far.

name: emit_packbits_runs
description: Walks the source and writes either a repeated-byte run or a literal run into the output with the matching control byte, returning the total count after each run.

name: count_matching_byte_run
description: Counts how many consecutive bytes equal the first byte, stopping at the end of the buffer or at a run length of 128. It is used to decide whether a run should be packed.

name: find_node_by_task_id
description: Fetches the current task identifier through the exec library and walks a linked list of records, returning the first record whose stored identifier matches, or null if none does.

name: reset_field_and_return_one
description: Clears a field in the target record when the test flag is not set, then returns one.

name: store_nonzero_field_value
description: Stores the incoming value in a field of the target record when that value is nonzero, then returns zero.

name: compute_size_flag_bits
description: Builds a flag word from a picture record: one bit is set when the first field is small and the second value is large, and a second bit is set when another value exceeds a limit.

name: load_ilbm_bitmap_header
description: Checks the form tag for an ILBM picture and, when the bitmap header matches the expected depth, copies the header fields into a local record and passes them to the decoder.

name: unpack_triplet_bytes_to_words
description: Converts consecutive three-byte groups into 16-bit words, placing the first byte in the high bits and the upper nibble of the third byte in the low bits. The output count is the data length divided by three.

name: return_call_result_plus_eight
description: Calls a subroutine and returns its result with eight added to it. The recovered body is partial, so the wider behaviour rests on the routine it calls.

name: allocate_task_record_node
description: When the lock flag is set and memory is allocated, it stores the current task identifier in the new node, clears its counter and links it into a list. It then increments a count and clears a pending bit in the record.

name: run_iff_library_entry_check
description: Entry point of the iff library file: it opens the DOS library, calls two of its routines, closes it again and returns a fixed error code of five.

name: open_dos_and_init_list
description: Library code that stores its argument in a record, opens the DOS library through the exec library and saves the returned base, then sets up an empty list head at a fixed offset in the record.

name: allocate_iff_task_node
description: Library code that, when the lock flag is set and memory is allocated, stores the current task identifier in the new node and links it into the list. It then increments a count and clears a pending bit in the record.

name: decrement_and_release_iff_node
description: Library code that decrements a countdown field in a node and, when the field reaches zero with a pending bit set, frees the node's memory and removes it from its list through the exec library.

name: release_node_or_mark_pending
description: Library code that frees the node and returns its stored result when the countdown is zero. Otherwise it sets a pending bit in the node and returns zero.

name: free_iff_node_and_return
description: Library code that removes a node from its list, closes its library, frees its memory through the exec library and returns the value stored in the node.

name: read_iff_form_header
description: Library code that reads the first chunk of an open IFF file and checks it is a FORM. It allocates a record for the form, records its size and returns a numbered error code for each failure.

name: open_iff_form_file

description: Opens the dos and graphics libraries through the exec library and stores their bases in a record. If either open fails it frees the record, otherwise it sets up an empty list head in the record.

name: unload_segment_list_entries
description: Walks a list of loaded segments, unlinks each entry whose use count is not positive, and unloads it through the DOS library.

name: release_node_when_unused
description: Closes the libraries held by a node, frees its memory and unlinks it from its list when the node is unused and not pending. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the node and returns zero.

name: mark_node_pending_return_zero
description: Sets the pending flag bit in a node and returns zero.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Does nothing and returns. It is referenced through a pointer held in data.

name: clear_pending_and_bump_counter
description: Clears the pending flag bit in a node and increments its counter field.

name: decrement_and_run_pending_call
description: Decrements a counter in a node and, when the counter is still nonzero and the pending flag is set, calls a library routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: compute_signed_position_offset
description: Computes a signed offset from the difference between two stored 16-bit positions, scaled by a fixed step, then adjusts it for each differing flag bit using a lookup table. It returns a large negative sentinel when the first position is zero.

name: load_font_from_fonts_directory
description: Builds a font file path under the fonts directory from a name in the record, then opens and reads the font through the DOS library and returns the load result.

name: copy_string_until_terminator
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the source to the destination, including the terminator.

name: append_string_to_end
description: Advances to the terminator of the destination string and then appends the source string there through a second routine.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without doing any other work.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string before its terminator and returns the count.

name: compare_strings_ordering
description: Compares two null-terminated strings character by character, returning minus one when the first is smaller, one when it is larger, and zero when they are equal.

name: compare_byte_ordering_result
description: Compares the byte at a stored position with the byte at the given pointer, returning minus one when the former is smaller and one otherwise.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for a given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or null when the string ends first.

name: find_char_from_pointer
description: Scans a null-terminated string from a stored pointer for a given character and returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the end is reached first.

name: find_last_character_in_string
description: Measures a string and then scans it backwards for a given character, returning a pointer to its last occurrence or null when it is absent.

name: find_path_separator_or_start
description: Returns the position of the last slash in a string, or of the last colon when there is no slash, or the start of the string when neither is present.

name: prepare_font_name_buffer
description: Diskfont library code that clears the first word of a buffer and computes its end pointer from the length. When a flag bit is set it walks the font list to locate the matching entry.

name: copy_font_glyph_rows
description: Diskfont library code that copies rows of glyph data from a source block into the destination, reducing the remaining size counter for each row.

name: store_font_record_from_bytes
description: Diskfont library code that copies bytes from the source into the destination one at a time and, when the buffer is full, writes a small record holding the count and the buffer address.

name: open_font_from_fonts_path
description: Diskfont library code that locates a font description file under the FONTS directory by examining the directory, opens the matching font file and allocates memory for the loaded data.

name: copy_font_data_block
description: Diskfont library code that copies font data into the destination in rows, advancing the source and destination pointers and calling a subroutine for each row.

name: read_font_header_chunk
description: Diskfont library code that reads font header data from the open file through the DOS library in fixed-size pieces and checks the leading value before copying the data.

name: read_font_record_and_close
description: Diskfont library code that reads a fixed-size path record from the open file, stores its fields in the output block, and closes the file through the DOS library.

name: unlock_and_return_status
description: Diskfont library code that releases a directory lock through the DOS library and returns the magnitude of a negative status code, or zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Diskfont library stub that returns zero immediately without other work.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Wrapper that calls one routine and returns without doing any other work.

name: call_single_routine_and_return
description: Wrapper that calls one routine and returns without doing any other work.

name: load_executable_hunks
description: Program entry of the SHOW utility that allocates memory and walks the executable's hunks, comparing hunk type codes to load or relocate its segments, then frees the memory it used.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub reached from a single call site.

name: spin_delay_loop
description: Counts a register down to zero in a tight loop, consuming time before returning.

name: render_text_run_with_colour
description: Reads a run of characters, accumulating widths for control values, writes the character data to the output and updates the COLOR01 colour register along the way.

name: cycle_character_code_counter
description: Steps a stored character value backward once per count, wrapping to a space character when it reaches zero.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Performs a store and a subtraction, then reaches data bytes the decompiler reads as an invalid instruction. It is a stub rather than a working routine.

name: service_task_message_port
description: Program entry that finds the current task, takes the system lock briefly, waits for and retrieves a message from the task's port, then releases the lock and calls its cleanup routines before returning zero.

name: wait_for_vertical_blank_frames
description: Waits for a number of frames by calling the graphics wait routine repeatedly, counting the argument down to zero.

name: start_game_main_loop
description: Main startup routine that loads the custom font, opens the diskfont, audio and timer resources and the music file, then sets up the display, sprite and scrolling playfield before running the game loop. It reports missing fonts or libraries and exits on the quit key.
